newsitem.title: CHINA: China nets $3.3 bln of smuggled goods in decade.
newsitem.headline: China nets $3.3 bln of smuggled goods in decade.

text.p: Chinese customs cracked more than 900,000 smuggling cases and confiscated more than 27.7 billion yuan ($3.3 billion) worth of contraband in 1987-1996, the International Business Daily said on Tuesday.

The smuggled goods included 21,708 motor vehicles, 1.15 million cartons of cigarettes, 1.2 million domestic electrical appliances, 91,924 antiques, 33 tonnes of drugs and a large amount of pornographic or "reactionary" publications, it said.
